messages.python.help:
Additional Python Creator route (Python 3.10+, Node.js 22+, Windows).
Run from the project root:
python Skin_Creator/Create-Skin.py start --session Skin_Creator/work/my-skin --state <Python-session.json> --id my-skin --name "My Skin"
Other commands use the same arguments as creator.mjs. Use Usage/Start-Skin.py for the separate managed Python session. The original entrypoints are preserved.
